top_categories.workout_context: When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
59 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Gran Fondo Kazakhstan's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Gran Fondo Kazakhstan's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before August.
Base fitness for Gran Fondo Kazakhstan. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
At Gran Fondo Kazakhstan, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Gran Fondo Kazakhstan's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 59 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Gran Fondo Kazakhstan. Train it until it feels boring.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Torque for headwinds and mixed terrain. When cadence drops below 70rpm, muscular strength keeps the watts up.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

race_overlay.heat: August in Almaty, Kazakhstan can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before Gran Fondo Kazakhstan. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Gran Fondo Kazakhstan’s 59 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.altitude: Gran Fondo Kazakhstan demands altitude preparation. Arrive 5–7 days early for acclimatization. Expect 5–15% power reduction at altitude. Increase iron intake 4 weeks out. Hydrate aggressively — altitude increases fluid loss by 20–40%.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, Durability, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 59 miles of mixed terrain in Almaty, Kazakhstan.
